# Buddhi Rangana - Portfolio

> Full-Stack Software Developer, Entrepreneur, and Founder of DigiFox Technologies & TEC ROOM based in Colombo, Sri Lanka.

## Overview
Buddhi Rangana is a Full-Stack Engineer and Tech Entrepreneur specializing in modern web applications, scalable cloud infrastructure, and AI integration. He is currently pursuing a BSc (Hons) in Information Technology at NIIBS Campus.

## Core Capabilities & Tech Stack
- **Frontend**: Next.js (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, HTML5, CSS3
- **Backend**: Node.js, PHP (Laravel / WordPress), RESTful APIs, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Firebase
- **Tooling & Cloud**: Git, GitHub, Vercel, Docker, Figma, Linux

## Academic Research
- **Title**: A Quantitative Study on the Impact of the Use of ChatGPT and Google Gemini on the Academic Performance of IT Undergraduates at NIIBS Campus
- **Authors**: Buddhi Rangana
- **Journal**: Journal of Research Technology and Engineering (JRTE)
- **DOI**: [10.5281/zenodo.21696248](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21696248)
